content.stem: 一名合规官正在处理一起案件，并已确定相关事件无需提交可疑活动报告(SAR)。以下哪两项应包含在案例记录中以证明不提交可疑活动报告(SAR)是合理的？(选择两项。)

options.A: 谁做出了不提交可疑活动报告(SAR)的决定
options.B: 该合规官为何认为此案不值得提交可疑活动报告(SAR)
options.D: 资金在该机构内的流动情况

content.stem_en: A compliance officer is completing a case and has determined that the events do not merit filing a suspicious activity report (SAR). Which of the following should be included in the case notes to justify not filing a SAR? (Choose Two.)

options_en.A: Who made the decision not to file the SAR
options_en.B: Why the officer deemed that the case did not merit filing a SAR
options_en.C: How much money was involved in the case
options_en.D: How the money flowed through the institution
